provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: Galois descent over Z[i]: the four conjugates of the target under Gal(Q(zeta_16)/Q(i)) span a space of dimension min(4, m + 1); no search

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; about 10 s for the certificate

llm.role: found the descent argument and wrote the certificate

notes: Puts the cell at 4 <= chi(|sqrtT>^4) <= 5. Galois descent: the four conjugates of |sqrtT>^4 under Gal(Q(zeta_16)/Q(i)) are independent (a Vandermonde on the weights 0 to 3), so any stabilizer span containing the target has dimension at least 4. Exact, computed as a rank over Q(zeta_16). The numerical rank-3 exclusion over the 36,720 four-qubit states (research survey, 2026-10-17: 1,548 pivots, 1,099,080 collinear candidates, closest approach 0.974) agrees. Rank 4 here would give gamma 1/2, matching the published exponent at a single cell; rank 5 gives 0.5805.
